# `company.shipment_revisions`

Append-only shipment revisions: each restatement or void adds one; the newest is current.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this revision. |
| `shipment_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with shipment_id + revision_number | — | shipments.id | Shipment this revision restates. |
| `revision_number` | INTEGER | no | — | unique with shipment_id + revision_number | — | — | One-based revision number; the newest is current and is the version. |
| `status` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | — | — | shipped or voided (draft and cancelled arrive with packing). |
| `ship_date` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | — | — | Date the stock left, YYYY-MM-DD: the entry's date. |
| `count_position` | VARCHAR(8) | no | — | — | — | — | before (the default) or after a count of its site on the same date. |
| `site_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | inventory_sites.id | Inventory site the shipment leaves. |
| `ship_method_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | ship_methods.id | Ship Via list entry; null when none. |
| `carrier` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Carrier or service, as text; null when blank. |
| `tracking_numbers` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | JSON array of tracking numbers as text, printed never fetched. |
| `ship_to` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Ship-to address as text; null when the order's. |
| `memo` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Memo as entered; null when blank. |
| `reason` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Why this revision was written, as the caller gave it. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this shipment revision was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this shipment revision. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this shipment revision. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this shipment revision. |
